executive_summary: Comprehensive Phase 5 evaluation across 108 synthetic benchmark scenarios and 108 independent holdout scenarios confirms that D+Opt failed to generalize on unseen holdout routes under urban canyon and heading-dropout conditions. Specifically, D+Opt breached 3 mandatory holdout release gates: All-Scheduled RMSE (9.64 m vs <8.00 m threshold), Distance Overcount (+3.31% vs <=1.00% threshold), and Signed Distance Bias (+3.22% vs <=1.00% threshold). Task 4 determinism verification achieved a TECHNICAL PASS on single-platform reproducibility, but cross-platform bit-exact equivalence remains INCONCLUSIVE due to IEEE-754 Float64 architecture variance. In accordance with Owner directives, Milestone 2B and production algorithm rollout remain on HOLD. Raw GPS Preservation and Cable-Free Export (RG-1 / RG-2) are decoupled into an independent workstream.

rmse_gate.observed_evidence: Significant position error divergence on high-curvature routes under severe noise profiles.

distance_overcount_gate.observed_evidence: Substantial distance inflation observed across multi-corner and Figure-8 holdout scenarios.

signed_distance_bias_gate.observed_evidence: Systematic positive net distance error accumulation across holdout trajectories with non-zero curvature.

p95_error_gate.observed_evidence: Error distribution remains bounded without runaway divergence.

legacy_availability_gate.observed_evidence: Filter tracking occupancy outside S2 Loss-of-Lock exceeded 99.9%.

measurement_validated_availability_gate.observed_evidence: Tracking epochs anchored by valid admitted measurements met the >=99.00% target.

recovery_latency_p95_gate.observed_evidence: FSM reacquisition (S3) to validated re-anchor (S4/S5) resolved within 22 seconds.

covariance_psd_gate.observed_evidence: 100% positive semi-definite error covariance matrices verified across all 75,600 holdout epochs via Jacobi and LDLT.

task4_deterministic_fingerprint.verdict: TECHNICAL_PASS (Determinism engine verified 100% on macOS ARM64; cross-platform bit-exact equivalence INCONCLUSIVE due to sub-micron Float64 transcendental variance)

task5_independent_holdout.verdict: VERIFIED_FAIL (3 Gates Breached: RMSE, Overcount, Signed Bias)

sign_off.owner_decision: NO-GO for current D+Opt; HOLD Milestone 2B; Decouple Raw GPS Preservation (RG-1/RG-2)
